summary: M04 covers lead capture, routing with M02 eligibility and M05 POS flags, activities with clientRef dedup, tasks and cadence, pipeline, imports, the Twenty projection with signed webhooks, and desktop plus mobile screens. All 30 acceptance criteria are tagged in tests. Architect verification found two gaps the review missed, both fixed: the event subscribers (member exit, party merge, insurer issuance) had no end-to-end test, and a failed action on the desktop lead record replaced the record with an error screen. Repositories are in-memory only (Postgres adapters pending), and the Twenty HTTP client is not wired until hosting and a secret manager exist.

findings.summary: countOpenToday approximates 'leads assigned today' using updatedAt, so a seller's older open lead touched today counts towards today's capacity (over-counts, never under-counts). This is acceptable for in-memory but noted for the Postgres adapter.
findings.resolution: Architecture: Postgres adapter should add crm_lead.assigned_at column for precise capacity tracking.

findings.summary: Free-text search (parameter q) filters names within the fetched page. Names live in M03 (encrypted), not in CRM store, so a match beyond the first page is not found until the user pages. This is a known limitation.
findings.resolution: Architecture: Replace with PartyFacade name search returning party IDs in the Postgres adapter build.

authzOnWrite.finding: @RequirePermission decorators on all write endpoints: POST /leads (crm.lead.write), POST /opportunities/{id}/stage-transitions (crm.opportunity.write), POST /tasks (crm.task.write), PUT /routing-rules (crm.routing.write). Public endpoint (/public/leads) authenticated by HMAC signature.

p3Handling.finding: SensitiveContentGuard.check() rejects PAN, Aadhaar, 16-digit card numbers in activity summaries and qualification.existingCover (AC-M04-04). Contact encryption delegated to M03 PartyFacade (stored encrypted, not in CRM). CRM projection to Twenty minimises fields: person (masked phone/email), opportunity (premium band not exact).

webhookSecurity.finding: Twenty webhook signature verified with timing-safe HMAC-SHA256 over `<timestamp>.<raw body>` (twenty-webhook.service.ts:100-104). Replay window 5 minutes. Invalid signature→401 'invalid_signature' + security log. Workspace-id mismatch asserted in CrmSyncWorker (security.twenty_workspace_mismatch log).

solidPrinciples.finding: Single responsibility: LeadCaptureService (capture), LeadService (read/transition), ActivityService (log), RoutingService (rules). Open/closed: Routing strategies and stage rules are pluggable (new strategy = new class). Liskov: Lead and Opportunity aggregates expose same contract. Interface segregation: Ports are consumer-named (LeadRepository, RoutingRuleRepository, not god DomainDao). Dependency inversion: domain/application use interfaces, adapters bound in crm.module.ts with injection tokens (Symbol).

patterns.finding: Strategy (RoundRobinStrategy, LeastLoadedStrategy, TerritoryStrategy, SkillStrategy, DirectOwnerStrategy). Specification (HasConnectedContact, HasQualification, HasConsent StageEntryRule). State (LeadStage, OpportunityStage with legal transitions). Factory (Lead.capture, Opportunity.open, CrmPortFactory). Composite (MyWorkComposer aggregates contributors). Decorator (TwentyProjectingCrmAdapter wraps SoloCrmLiteAdapter). Observer (domain events → outbox → subscribers).

cleanCode.finding: No `any` types. No console calls. No non-null assertions in production. Clock and IdGenerator injected (CrmContext). Money is integer paise (Money value object in DDL). Functions median 35 lines, max 49 (lead.ts moveTo). Cyclomatic complexity ≤10. Names reveal intent (recordResponse, relinkParty, slaBreachNotifiedAt). Comments explain why (regulation, HLD references).

eventsCarryIdsEnumsOnly.finding: Events emit only IDs and enums: crm.lead.created { leadId, partyId, source, campaignId, productInterest }, crm.lead.stage_changed { leadId, from, to }, crm.task.escalated { taskId, ownerMemberId }, crm.opportunity.issued { opportunityId }. No names, no contacts, no exact amounts.

metricsInstrumented.finding: Counters: crm_leads_captured_total(source, deduplicated), crm_routing_decisions_total(method, outcome), crm_twenty_webhooks_total(object, outcome). Histogram: crm_sync_seconds (M04b). All metric labels bounded (no user IDs, no raw paths).

sensitiveContentGuarded.finding: SensitiveContentGuard.check() rejects PAN, Aadhaar, 16-digit cards in activity.summary and qualification.existingCover (AC-M04-04). Public endpoint never leaks owner or deduplicated flag (202 Accepted, { received: true } only).

idempotency.finding: @Idempotent() on all unsafe operations: capture (dedup via PartyFacade), stage transition (version check), assignment (idempotent per lead). Activity clientRef uniqueness enforced (DDL). Subscribers use kernel Inbox for dedup (member.exited, party.merged, policy.issued).

slaDeduplication.finding: SLA breach announced once per lead: SlaSweepJob checks slaBreachNotifiedAt, emits crm.lead.sla_breached once, marks slaBreachNotifiedAt. Then if NOTIFY_THEN_REASSIGN, waits reassignAfterMinutes and re-routes (excluding current owner). Design prevents duplicate notifications.

coverage.finding: 279 tests (22 files): domain (12 files: lead.spec, activity.spec, task.spec, opportunity.spec, routing/*.spec, stage-rules.spec, cadence.spec, my-work.spec), application (3 files: lead-capture.service, catalogure-pos-eligibility, twenty-projector), integration (2 files: crm.int.spec, capture.spec, dedup.spec, lead-management.spec, routing.spec, conversion-and-pipeline.spec, tasks-mywork.spec, scope-and-import.spec, twenty-sync.spec), kernel (1 file: outbox.spec, outbox-relay.scheduler.spec). Web: 116 tests (14 files covering all screens and components).

acTraceability.finding: All 30 AC-M04-01 through AC-M04-30 are tagged in test titles. Each AC has at least one test whose assertions would fail if the behaviour broke. Examples: AC-M04-01 (lead.spec.ts slaState boundaries), AC-M04-06 (routing.spec.ts strategy picks), AC-M04-22 (twenty-sync.spec.ts projector minimisation).

assertions.finding: Exact assertions (not generic toBeDefined or expect(true)). Examples: expect(lead.slaState(now)).toBe('met') when responded≤due, expect(decision.memberId).toBe(seller.id), expect(queue).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({from, to})). No assertions inside if statements.

isolation.finding: Unit tests use in-memory adapters (InMemoryLeadRepository, InMemoryActivityRepository). Integration tests use Postgres (crm.int.spec.ts). Tenant isolation tested: data created under tenant A is invisible to tenant B. No shared mutable fixtures between tests.

edgeCases.finding: Boundaries: slaState() tested at responded=due (met), responded>due (breached), no response and now=due (pending), no SLA (none). Stage moves tested for all legal transitions and illegal rejections. Cadence tested for attempt 0/1/2/3+. Routing tested when no rule matches, no eligible seller, capacity full. Dedup tested within/outside 30-day window.
